verdict.rationale: Rippling ships first-party programmatic surfaces: an official CLI whose Flux commands create, manage and deploy Rippling-hosted integrations, plus platform APIs and a developer sandbox. These could plausibly be scripted outside the UI, but nothing in the pack documents headless or CI usage. Missing for 10: documented CI/headless usage (non-interactive auth, service tokens, pipeline examples), evidence that the CLI or API can automate core product operations beyond integration deployment, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
